title: Local and Global Stability in Performative Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.06467v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In performative reinforcement learning the deployed policy shapes the environment that generates the learner's future data, and the natural solution concept is a performatively stable policy that is optimal in the environment it induces. Existing convergence guarantees rely on Lipschitz sensitivity assumptions on the environment map $\pi \mapsto (P_\pi, r_\pi)$, which are hard to verify and fail in settings such as multi-agent best-response dynamics. We instead study stability for mixtures of policies, and show that the resulting picture is fundamentally different from performative prediction, where randomization removes the need for any sensitivity assumption. We distinguish local mixed stability, an occupancy-weighted first-order relaxation that we show is equivalent to stationarity, from global mixed stability, which certifies against arbitrary deviating policies. translated_title: 表演性强化学习中的局部与全局稳定性
translated_abstract: 在表演性强化学习中，部署的策略会塑造生成学习者未来数据的环境，自然的解概念是表演性稳定策略，即在其自身所诱导的环境中是最优的策略。现有的收敛性保证依赖于环境映射 $\pi \mapsto (P_\pi, r_\pi)$ 上的Lipschitz敏感性假设，这类假设难以验证，并且在多智能体最优响应动态等场景中会失效。我们转而研究策略混合的稳定性，并证明由此得到的图景与表演性预测有着根本性的不同——在表演性预测中，随机化可以完全消除对敏感性假设的需求。我们区分了两类概念：局部混合稳定性，这是一种按占用度加权的二阶松弛，我们证明它等价于平稳性；以及全局混合稳定性，它能够对任意偏离的策略提供稳定性保证。我们的第一个结果表明，一种按状态加权的Hedge动态驱使…
tldr: 该论文研究了表演性强化学习中策略混合的稳定性，提出了局部混合稳定性（等价于平稳性）与全局混合稳定性两种新概念，从而摆脱了传统收敛性保证对难以验证的Lipschitz敏感性假设的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper studies stability of policy mixtures in performative reinforcement learning, introducing local mixed stability (equivalent to stationarity) and global mixed stability, thereby removing the reliance on hard-to-verify Lipschitz sensitivity assumptions required by existing convergence guarantees.
